# UPIIXIA Agentic Kit · Roblox (uak)

> Multi-agent coordination for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI), set up to build Roblox games with Rojo, Luau, Lune, selene and StyLua. Several humans and agents work in parallel on one repo with no server: claims, leases, test-first, reviews of the exact commit and a gated merge queue, all stored on a Git branch. The Roblox stack adds a Rojo template, a product smoke that needs no Studio (selene, stylua, Lune tests, rojo build), a Luau design lint (colors and fonts only in Theme.luau) and a place publisher through Open Cloud that only a human runs. Two modes: sprint (game jams) and marathon (a live game). Bash 3.2 + Git only. MIT. Fork of JoahanMorales/upiixia-agentic-kit.

Install into a game repo: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/devmoraless/upiixia-agentic-kit-roblox ~/.uak-kit && bash ~/.uak-kit/install.sh --mode sprint --stack roblox .`, then `bash .uak/bin/uak start`.
